note: M09 development evidence only (D92, D93), extended by D106. The consumption contract is pinned against each producer's main branch: cordanaLLM/imago decodes both Aegis payloads at the commit named here, and cordanaLLM/nucleus verifies build/kernel-requirement.json with its scripts/verify_kernel_requirement.py at the commit named here. `make contract-fetch` retains `git ls-remote --heads` for both producers, clones both at their commits into a cache outside the repository and builds imago with GOTOOLCHAIN=local CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -buildvcs=true; the gate inside `make verify-all` never touches the network. Nothing is published to either producer from here.
